title: just-deliver environment descriptor
description: What an environment publishes to the workloads deployed on it. name, region and type are addressable as env.name, env.region and env.type (the only env.* paths); a deployed part's export is read as ${<part>.<export>} from values. Checked against the catalog, not here: the type is declared, and a type with `approval: true` carries the `approval` block.

name.description: Environment name; same pattern as workload ids.

type.description: An environment type the catalog declares.

offers.description: The components and runtime the environment offers, as its definition names them; a shared layer's descriptor offers nothing, so no workload can deploy on it.

values.description: The exports of the parts `jd env up` deployed, keyed by part name (values.<part>.<export>), the base descriptor's included: nested mappings of strings. Keys are non-empty and contain no dot, so a dot path is unambiguous: a flat `a.b` key would shadow nested `a: { b }`.

additionalProperties.description: Any key the pattern does not match: refused with this message (the validator ignores propertyNames).

x-jd.message: keys must be non-empty and must not contain '.'; nest a mapping instead (a: { b: … }).
